question: __________ was elected as the president of the third session of Indian National Congress.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Badruddin Tyabji**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Badruddin Tyabji** was elected as the president of the third session of the Indian National Congress.
 
• The third session of the Indian National Congress was held in **Madras** in 1887.
 
• Badruddin Tyabji was the first Muslim to hold the position of president of the Indian National Congress.
 
• He was a prominent lawyer and a social reformer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Indian National Congress was founded in 1885 by **A.O. Hume**, a retired British civil servant.
 
• The first session of the Indian National Congress was held in **Bombay** in December 1885, with **Womesh Chunder Bonnerjee** as the president.
 
• The second session of the Congress was held in **Calcutta** in 1886, with **Dadabhai Naoroji** as the president.
 
• The Indian National Congress played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• It aimed to obtain a greater share in government for educated Indians and to create a platform for civic and political dialogue.
